BiblicalUsage: God teaches David's hands to war so that a bow of brass is broken by his arms, and the LORD promises to break in pieces the gates of brass before Cyrus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe brass breaks before the LORD either way: in David's hands it is the enemy's bow snapping, and before Cyrus it is the gates of Babylon falling, and the same God breaks both.
